text: Hello, uncle ah sorry to disturb your lunch. Just checking if you received the court notice sent to your Jurong address. Actually this one is from State Courts investigation registry ah. You never respond so magistrate issue order already must settle today before three pm.

Hello, sister you order parcel from Lazada right. The delivery driver say custom duty haven pay so cannot release. This one is Ninja Van express delivery centre. Faster transfer the release deposit now otherwise parcel return back to overseas seller.

Hello, we have received an update about a delivery registered under your name. There appears to be an issue with the shipment record, and the parcel may be held temporarily. I am a Singapore Customs investigation officer working with the courier, and I need you to attend a video verification session before release.
I am from the courier company handling your Lazada parcel. The driver cannot complete delivery without a two dollar verification payment via PayNow. Send it now please.

Good day. An express package from London containing gold bullion under your name is currently impounded at Changi Airfreight Centre. I am the DHL customs clearing supervisor. To avoid police interrogation please make payment for the clearance permit through our temporary escrow facility.

Hello, sister your online order for branded handbag got problem with the merchant terminal. The money already deducted but the merchant side frozen. This is Shopee dispute resolution centre. You must quickly verify your bank card number and the three digit CVV code at the back.

Did you order some expensive electronic equipment from overseas last week. The consignment is stuck at the warehouse because the declaration papers are completely invalid. My name is Alan and I am calling directly from DHL Express Singapore. You need to wire the clearance tax to avoid prosecution.

Hello. I am calling from the Singtel customer care billing team. We noticed a billing discrepancy on your latest broadband statement where an incorrect equipment charge was applied. A full credit waiver of thirty dollars has been credited to your account and no payment required on your end.

An order associated with your Shopee account has been selected for a compliance review. The release process requires confirmation of the outstanding processing charge. I am from the platform's delivery resolution team, and I can arrange for the parcel to be released once you complete the payment verification.

We noticed a discrepancy in the details submitted for your recent work pass renewal. Could you confirm whether you received the earlier notification? I can help explain the next steps and the documents required. For your reference, I am calling from the Ministry of Manpower enforcement team.

Your parcel has been delayed, and the delivery record requires additional confirmation. We can explain the options for arranging another delivery attempt. Please have your tracking reference available when we continue. I am an officer from the Singapore Police Force handling a shipment-related investigation.

This is Dr. Lim's office at Raffles Medical. Your Medisave claim for last month's procedure was rejected, so you'll need to settle the outstanding $1,200 by tonight or we'll cancel your follow-up appointment.
You are required to appear in court next week. Failure to attend will result in a warrant. This is the State Courts of Singapore.
We've received a report about your involvement in an illegal transaction. I'm Sergeant Nurul from Bedok Police Station. You need to come down today or we'll issue a warrant.
Hello, we need to verify your account. Please read out the OTP we just sent to your phone. This is urgent — your account will be blocked if you don't.

Your pending online purchase on Lazada has been halted by customs because the seller registered it as hazardous material under your contact number. You must wire an emergency indemnification deposit to avoid receiving a notice of prosecution at your registered address. Lazada logistics compliance unit is handling this file.

Hello, I am sending you a six-digit verification code to your phone number right now because I accidentally entered your digits on my registration form. Could you please read back the SMS code you just received so I can complete my profile? It will only take two seconds of your time.

You have an undeclared taxable allowance of SGD 4,200 in your annual income records. If the discrepancy remains unresolved, penalties may follow; the caller handling this case is from IRAS investigation services.

The parcel delivery address has been marked as invalid, and your shipment will be returned unless you update the recipient record. I represent Ninja Van Singapore's customs verification desk, and the correction fee is SGD 6.20.

Hello. We're updating the nomination records for members born in your year, and yours appears incomplete. It will take only a minute to update. Could you read me the six digits that will be sent to your phone? This is the CPF Board member services line.

Hello. A parcel addressed to you has been held at the Changi airfreight centre because it contains undeclared items. A clearance fee of three hundred and eighty dollars must be paid by today to release it. I'm calling from the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority customs liaison.

Good morning. You were listed as a witness in a civil matter, and the hearing has been brought forward to Thursday. Because your details were entered wrongly, the court needs you to confirm your NRIC and the card you used for the filing fee. The call is from the Supreme Court registry.

Hi ah, congratulations, you won a prize from our lucky draw, one holiday package to Phuket! Just need you to pay the tax and handling fee first, then we send the voucher to you. Very fast one, can finish today.

Hello, I'm calling from the Singapore Police Force regarding a courier delivery you refused last week. The delivery is now classed as evidence, and a refundable bond of three hundred dollars must be paid so we can return the item. Please transfer it today.
Hello, I'm calling from UOB regarding your recent application. There's an issue with the documents you submitted. Can you confirm your NRIC number so we can pull up your file?
Good morning, HSBC calling. There's a problem with your recent transfer. The funds are stuck and we need your OTP to release them. Can you read me the code you just received?
Hi, I'm from the insurance company. Your claim has been approved but we need your bank login details to process the payment. Can you provide them now?
Hello, Singpass support here. Your account has been accessed from a new device. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, please reset your password immediately.

Good day, your recent outbound consignment held at the processing hub contains undeclared commercial lithium batteries in violation of aviation guidelines. Our duty supervisor requires an immediate security bond transfer before this matter is escalated to regulators. This is the central transit facility at SingPost.

Good morning, our platform monitoring team detected that your recent retail delivery failed because import insurance levies remain unpaid at the domestic warehouse. Please install our remote inspection tool so our fulfillment agent can help clear the merchant invoice on your screen. This is Lazada customer logistics.

Good day, your courier consignment has arrived at our Jurong distribution warehouse with outstanding freight adjustment charges. Payment must be processed immediately using our priority settlement portal to avoid forfeiture of the goods. I am representing DHL Singapore.

Good morning, your merchant shopfront account on our mobile app has been temporarily restricted due to unfulfilled trade verification fees. To reactivate your profile, our dispute manager needs to walk you through a WhatsApp video verification process. Calling from Lazada merchant services.

Good afternoon, this is M1 fraud prevention desk calling about an alert on your account. We noticed three consecutive roaming data passes purchased within thirty minutes from a European destination, and we temporarily halted roaming charges to protect you. If this was indeed your purchase, please confirm so we can restore roaming access.

Hello, our algorithmic trading platform guarantees daily returns of twelve percent on cryptocurrency arbitrage with zero downside risk. If you open your portfolio with a small capital deposit today, our senior wealth manager will execute trades on your behalf.

Hey, I just sent a six-digit verification code to your mobile number by mistake while trying to recover my gaming profile. Could you please read out that code to me right now so I can unlock my account?

Hello, this is regarding a discrepancy in your household utilities account, and we need to resolve it before the next billing cycle. I'm calling from SP Group, and our system shows two meter readings that don't match the submitted figures, so I'll arrange for a technician to check the installation.

Hello, we are reviewing an inconsistency in the eligibility details submitted for your household utilities rebate, and the case has been marked as time-sensitive. I'm calling from the Ministry of Health, and the assigned officer will contact you through WhatsApp to obtain your Singpass password and complete the assessment before the benefit expires.

Hello, your clinic subsidy record got mismatch ah, and the review officer needs to check your details before approving the next visit. I'm calling from the polyclinic, can share the code that comes in your SMS and don't contact the counter yet because they haven't received the investigation notice.
